description: Autonomous agents may not mutate RADIUS / AAA / ClearPass identity policy — service enforcement, role mapping, authentication method changes. Agents can propose the change and log the recommendation; the commit must be approved by a human (Level 5 autonomy).
message: Blocked: this action would modify RADIUS / AAA / ClearPass identity policy. Identity enforcement changes must be approved by a human — an agent can log the recommendation but cannot commit.
guidance: Write the recommended RADIUS/AAA change to remediation.log with the target device, current policy diff, and rationale, then page the identity on-call. An authorized operator can commit the change from the Conduct console.
